    SUBROUTINE CARGATEF;                                                          15753000
    BEGIN                                                                         15754000
                                                                                  15755000
       IF FESTIVO THEN                                                            15756000
          BEGIN                                                                   15757000
             GO TO FINCARGATEF;                                                   15758000
          END;                                                                    15759000
                                                                                  15760000
       ARCHTEFOK  := FALSE;                                                       15761000
                                                                                  15762000
       IF FECH176TEF = 0 THEN                                                     15763000
          BEGIN                                                                   15764000
             PARAM100:= "1";                                                      15765000
             SUB100;                                                              15766000
             FECHARCHTEF := T100(VALUE) / 100;                                    15767000
             NODOSIST    := T100(VALUE) MOD 100;                                  15768000
          END                                                                     15769000
       ELSE                                                                       15770000
          BEGIN                                                                   15771000
             FECHARCHTEF := FECH176TEF;                                           15772000
             NODOSIST    := NODO;                                                 15773000
          END;                                                                    15774000
                                                                                  15775000
%%valida residencia archivo TEF %%%%%%%%                                          15776000
                                                                                  15777000
       ARCHTEF := "(S500)S500/FILE/S500/TEF/" &                                   15778000
                  STRING(FECHARCHTEF,6) & " ON CAPTACION";                        15779000
       INTENTOSTEF := 1;                                                          15780000
      WAITFILETEF:                                                                15781000
       WAIT(10);                                                                  15782000
       IF (FILE #ARCHTEF IS RESIDENT ) THEN                                       15783000
          ARCHTEFOK := TRUE;                                                      15784000
       ELSE                                                                       15785000
          BEGIN                                                                   15786000
             INTENTOSTEF := INTENTOSTEF + 1;                                      15787000
             IF INTENTOSTEF > 29 THEN                                             15788000
                BEGIN                                                             15789000
                   MENSAJE:= MSGHDR & "O>030406<" & ARCHTEF                       15790000
                          & " NO RESIDENTE, 5 MIN ESPERA: "                       15791000
                          & " DAME OPCION: R=(SIGO ESPERNADO),"                   15792000
                          & " T=(TERMINA PROCESO)";                               15793000
                   PREGTEF:=ACCEPT(MENSAJE);                                      15794000
                   IF PREGTEF = "R" THEN                                          15795000
                      BEGIN                                                       15796000
                         INTENTOSTEF := 1;                                        15797000
                         GO TO WAITFILETEF;                                       15798000
                      END;                                                        15799000
                   ELSE                                                           15800000
                      GO TO FINCARGATEF;                                          15801000
                END;                                                              15802000
             ELSE                                                                 15803000
                GO TO WAITFILETEF;                                                15804000
          END;                                                                    15805000
%%%%%%%%%% PARA TRANSFERIR ARCHIVOS DE VDM A MTY %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%                  15806000
        IF NODO = 10 AND ARCHTEFOK THEN                                           15807000
           BEGIN                                                                  15808000
              PARAMXFER := "55 " & STRING(FECHARCHTEF,8) & " /00";                15809000
              PROCESS SUB197(PARAMXFER);                                          15810000
              WAIT(20);                                                           15811000
           END;                                                                   15812000
                                                                                  15813000
        IF OPC176TEF = 0 AND ARCHTEFOK THEN                                       15814000
           BEGIN                                                                  15815000
              VALUE176TEF := 2;                                                   15816000
              SUB176TEF;                                                          15817000
           END;                                                                   15818000
                                                                                  15819000
        IF OPC176TEF = 2 AND ARCHTEFOK THEN                                       15820000
           BEGIN                                                                  15821000
              PARAM4010TEF := STRING(FECH176TEF,8) & "2";                         15822000
              VALUE176TEF  := (DECIMAL(PARAM4010TEF));                            15823000
              SUB176TEF;                                                          15824000
           END;                                                                   15825000
                                                                                  15826000
%%      IF ARCHTEFOK THEN                                                         15827000

  SUBROUTINE VALIDAROLLBACK;                                                      15986000
    BEGIN                                                                         15987000
       ROLBCKOK := FALSE;                                                         15988000
         IJ := (DECIMAL(AUX1));                                                   15989000
         IT := (DECIMAL(AUX2));                                                   15990000
       ANOX := TAKE(AUX3,4);                                                      15991000
       MESX := TAKE((DROP(AUX3,4)),2);                                            15992000
       DIAX := TAKE((DROP(AUX3,6)),2);                                            15993000
       HRSX := TAKE(AUX4,2);                                                      15994000
       MINX := TAKE((DROP(AUX4,2)),2);                                            15995000
       SEGX := TAKE((DROP(AUX4,4)),2);                                            15996000
                                                                                  15997000
       IF (IJ > 0 AND IJ < 100000)                                                15998000
      AND (IT > 0 AND IT < 100000)                                                15999000
          THEN                                                                    16000000
           ROLBCKOK := TRUE                                                       16001000
       ELSE                                                                       16002000
          DISPLAY MSGHDR & "I>020501<"& "ERROR NUJOB/NUMIX";                      16003000
                                                                                  16004000
       IF ROLBCKOK  THEN                                                          16005000
          BEGIN                                                                   16006000
            IF (DECIMAL(ANOX) > 2000 AND DECIMAL(ANOX) < 3000)                    16007000
           AND (DECIMAL(MESX) > 0    AND DECIMAL(MESX) < 13  )                    16008000
           AND (DECIMAL(DIAX) > 0    AND DECIMAL(DIAX) < 32  )                    16009000
                THEN                                                              16010000
                ROLBCKOK := TRUE;                                                 16011000
            ELSE                                                                  16012000
              BEGIN                                                               16013000
               DISPLAY MSGHDR & "I>020501<"& "ERROR AAAAMMDD";                    16014000
               ROLBCKOK := FALSE;                                                 16015000
              END;                                                                16016000
          END;                                                                    16017000
                                                                                  16018000
       IF ROLBCKOK  THEN                                                          16019000
          BEGIN                                                                   16020000
            IF (DECIMAL(HRSX) < 24)                                               16021000
           AND (DECIMAL(MINX) < 60)                                               16022000
           AND (DECIMAL(SEGX) < 60)                                               16023000
                THEN                                                              16024000
                MES(MESX);                                                        16025000
            ELSE                                                                  16026000
              BEGIN                                                               16027000
               DISPLAY MSGHDR & "I>020501<"& "ERROR HHMMSS";                      16028000
               ROLBCKOK := FALSE;                                                 16029000
              END;                                                                16030000
          END;                                                                    16031000
                                                                                  16032000
%%     IF ROLBCKOK THEN                                                           16033000
%%        MES(MESX);                                                              16034000
                                                                                  16035000
    END;                                                                          16036000

  SUBROUTINE ARMAROLLBACK;                                                        17042000

     END;                                                                         17053000

%                SUBS006P940C(PARAMP940C,PARAMP940FEC);                           17194000
%%TRANSFERENCIA VIA S022                                                          17195000
        SACATIT("S500P197");P197:=TIT;                                            17196000
         FECHARCH := FECHABATCH;                                                  17197000
        PARAMXS022 := "95 " & STRING(FECHARCH,8) & " /00";                        17198000

         WAIT(1);                                                                 17200000

 SUBROUTINE SUB115 (INTEGER VALUE115);                                            17379120
  BEGIN                                                                           17379130
    ON RESTART,                                                                   17379140
    BEGIN                                                                         17379150
      GO PASO115;                                                                 17379160
    END;                                                                          17379170
    ON TASKFAULT,                                                                 17379180
    BEGIN                                                                         17379190
      FALLA(P115,"S500P115");                                                     17379210
      IF OPCION = "C" THEN                                                        17379220
         GO BACKFORZA115                                                          17379230
      ELSE                                                                        17379280
      IF OPCION = "V" THEN                                                        17379330
         BEGIN                                                                    17379335
            P115:=TIT2;                                                           17379340
            GO PASO115;                                                           17379350
         END;                                                                     17379360
      ELSE                                                                        17379362
         GO PASO115;                                                              17379364
    END;                                                                          17379370
    PASO115:                                                                      17379380
    T115(STATUS = NEVERUSED);                                                     17379390
    JOBATRIBUTOS;                                                                 17379400
    TASKATRIBUTOS;                                                                17379410
    RUN  #P115 [T115]; VALUE=VALUE115;                                            17379430
    BDNAME = #("S500/LIST/P115");                                                 17379440
    FILE TASKFILE (USERBACKUPNAME,TITLE = #("S500/TASKFILE/P115/"&                17379450
            STRING(FECHALIST,6) / TIMEDATE(HHMMSS)));                             17379460
    ON RESTART, GO BACKFORZA115;                                                  17379470
    ON TASKFAULT, GO BACKFORZA115;                                                17379480
    BACKFORZA115:                                                                 17379490
    IF VALUE115 = 00 THEN                                                         17379500
       RUN  SYSTEM/FORZA("S500/LIST/P115");                                       17379510
  END;                                                                            17379520

 SUBROUTINE PROCGCE;                                                              17379560
  BEGIN                                                                           17379570

    PARAM100:= "8";                                                               17379650
    SUB100;                                                                       17379660
%%  T100(VALUE) tiene fecha lote y csi      % aaaammddxx                          17379670
    FECHAMAQ:=T100(VALUE) / 100;          % aaaammdd                              17379680
    NODOSIST:=T100(VALUE) MOD 100;        % xx                                    17379690

                    REMUEVEBACKUPS(115);                                          17380060
                    SUB115(20);                                                   17380090
                  END;                                                            17380100
               ELSE                                                               17380110
                 BEGIN                                                            17380120
                   HHMMX:=TAKE(TIMEDATE(HHMMSS),4);                               17380130
                   IF (ESPBAACEPT   AND DECIMAL(HHMMX) > 1900) OR                 17380140
                      (ESDESARROLLO AND DECIMAL(HHMMX) > 1900) OR                 17380145

                       WAIT(300);                                                 17380280

 SUBROUTINE DIATELETON;                                                           17386050
   BEGIN                                                                          17386100
      FECHAY := FECHALIST;                                                        17386102
                                                                                  17386104
      IF IDTELETON = 0 THEN                                                       17386110
            GO TO FINDIATELETON;                                                  17386120
                                                                                  17386130
      VALUE629 := IDTELETON;                                                      17386135
                                                                                  17386140
      IF IDTELETON = 1 THEN                                                       17386150
         BEGIN                                                                    17386200
            CREABASEBD06;                                                         17386250
            SUB629;                                                               17386300
            SUBELINTELE;                                                          17386350
         END                                                                      17386400
      ELSE                                                                        17386450
         BEGIN                                                                    17386500
            BAJALINTELE;                                                          17386550
            SUB630;                                                               17386600
                                                                                  17386610
            SUB151109TEL;                                                         17386620
            WAIT(06);                                                             17386624
                                                                                  17386626
            SUB151104;                                                            17386628
            WAIT(05);                                                             17386630
                                                                                  17386640
            RESPALDATELE;                                                         17386650
            IF IDTELETON = 3 THEN                                                 17386700
               BEGIN                                                              17386750
                 REMB06FILETEL;                                                   17386760
                 SUB629;                                                          17386800
               END;                                                               17386850
            ELSE                                                                  17386900
               BEGIN                                                              17386910
                 CREABASEBD06;                                                    17386920
                 SUB629;                                                          17386930
                 SUBELINTELE;                                                     17386940
               END;                                                               17386950
         END;                                                                     17386960
                                                                                  17386962
    FINDIATELETON:                                                                17386964
                                                                                  17386966
   END;                                                                           17386970

  SUBROUTINE ENVIAMOTOR;                                                          17938010
    BEGIN                                                                         17938020
      ARCHMOTOR := "(S500)S500/FILE/S500/MOTOR/" &                                17938030
                   STRING(NODOSIST,2) & "/" & STRING(FECHABATCH,8) &              17938040
                   " ON CAPTACION";                                               17938050
                                                                                  17938055
      ARCHMOTOROK:= FALSE;                                                        17938060
      INTENTMOTOR := 1;                                                           17938070
      WAITMOTOR:                                                                  17938072
      WAIT(15);                                                                   17938074
      IF (FILE #ARCHMOTOR IS RESIDENT ) THEN                                      17938076
        BEGIN                                                                     17938077
          ARCHMOTOROK:= TRUE;                                                     17938078
        END;                                                                      17938080
      ELSE                                                                        17938081
          BEGIN                                                                   17938082
             INTENTMOTOR := INTENTMOTOR + 1;                                      17938084
             IF INTENTMOTOR  > 180 THEN                                           17938086
                BEGIN                                                             17938088
                   MENSAJE:= MSGHDR & "O>030406<" & ARCHMOTOR                     17938090
                          & " NO RESIDENTE, ESPERO 45 MINUTOS MAS "               17938092
                          & ", OK CONTINUAR";                                     17938093
                   INTENTMOTOR := 1;                                              17938094
                   WAIT (MENSAJE,OK);                                             17938095
                   GO TO WAITMOTOR;                                               17938096
                END;                                                              17938098
             ELSE                                                                 17938100
               GO TO WAITMOTOR;                                                   17938102
          END;                                                                    17938120
                                                                                  17938125
      IF NODOSIST = 04 THEN                                                       17938130
         PARAMOTOR := "20 " & STRING(FECHABATCH,8) & " /00";                      17938135
      ELSE                                                                        17938140
         PARAMOTOR := "56 " & STRING(FECHABATCH,8) & " /00";                      17938145
                                                                                  17938150
      SUB197(PARAMOTOR);                                                          17938155
    END;                                                                          17938160
                                                                                  17938200

     END;                                                                         17938660

  SUBROUTINE COPYARCHMCH;                                                         17938905
